thread:
Vera N: Observed in user testing: reviewers want a keyboard-first flow for bulk-approvals in Scorecards. Current modal traps mouse-first micro-interactions and the Undo snackbar disappears before SR users can reach it.
Cal P: Can you summarize the main pain? Is it focus management or timing?
Vera N: Both. When you confirm bulk-approve the modal closes and a snackbar appears with 'Undo' but focus returns to the grid's top. Screen-reader users have to tab many times to hit Undo. Also some users reflexively press Enter and accidentally confirm.
Juniper L: Ugh. We should prioritize keyboard order: after confirming, focus should land on the snackbar's Undo, or at least a visually-offscreen link that SRs can access.
Ming W: Implementation note: Undo is transient; making it focusable and polite-announced should be doable. But if we autofocus into the snackbar it could be jarring for mouse users.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: set role="status" with aria-live="polite" on snackbar and render an offscreen (sr-only) Undo button that receives focus for keyboard users; do not move mouse focus. Provide a persistent 'Activity history' link for people who missed Undo.
Cal P: Another asks: show an explicit 'Are you sure?' step for very large batches (>1000) with typed confirmation to prevent accidental Enter confirms.
Juniper L: Agree. Maybe thresholds: <=200: quick modal + snackbar Undo; 201-1000: modal requires explicit checkbox 'I understand'; >1000: typed confirm showing exact count.
Vera N: Also request from testers: show a small summary line inside modal: "This will mark 342 items as Pass. Affected scope: This run only." Users wanted the scope dropdown larger and keyboard reachable.
Ming W: Backend-wise we can return affected_count in the approval preview payload. Client can render counts and scope options. No heavy lift.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist I'll need: 1) snackbar role/status + sr-only undo button with tabindex=0; 2) announce counts in the modal before confirm; 3) ensure typed confirm uses aria-describedby to reference consequences text; 4) ensure focus returns to the originating row after action.
qa-bot: From QA perspective: add tests for keyboard-only flow, SR narration of counts, undo timing, and typed-confirm acceptance patterns.
Cal P: Microcopy proposals for the modal (short):
- Header: "Confirm bulk approval"
- Body: "This will mark 342 cases as Pass in this run. You can undo for 10s."
- Danger helper (for >1000): "This affects 1,204 cases. Type the number 1204 to confirm."
Juniper L: For the undo snackbar: "Approved 342 cases. Undo" and SR text: "342 items approved. Undo available." Keep it short.
Vera N: Action items:
- Ming: include affected_count + scope in approval preview API.
- Juniper: implement keyboard-first snackbar with sr-only Undo and focus rules.
- a11y-bot: post ARIA snippets and tests.
- qa-bot: add regression tests for keyboard flows.
- Cal: finalize copy and threshold numbers.
Ming W: I'll open the API PR today and add a flag 'require_typed_confirm' when count > 1000.
Juniper L: I'll ship a small prototype and drop frames in #design tomorrow.
Vera N: Thanks — let's capture failures in the UX sync and roll this into the next patch. If anyone has objections to thresholds, speak now. :white_check_mark:
